name: std::chrono::tzdb::locate_zone
intro: Obtains a pointer to a std::chrono::time_zone in this database that represents the time zone designated by tz_name. If p is the returned pointer, then either p->name() == tz_name or that there is a std::chrono::time_zone_link l in this database such that p->name() == l.target() && l.name() == tz_name.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer to the std::chrono::time_zone in this database that represents the time zone designated by tz_name.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws std::runtime_error if no such time_zone can be found.
